methodology.processScope: Only PIDs returned by SystemInfo.getProcessInfo on this disposable browser connection; no process-name enumeration.
methodology.memory: Windows WorkingSet64 and PrivateMemorySize64 (private committed bytes, not private resident memory); Linux VmRSS and smaps_rollup private clean+dirty+hugetlb where permitted. Working-set/RSS sums may double-count shared pages and are not exclusive physical memory.
methodology.sampling: Bounded post-action stage snapshots; maxima are observed stage samples, not exact transient peaks. No forced GC. Action duration excludes snapshots, whose wall time and sampler work are reported separately. Playwright overhead remains included.
methodology.fixtures: Deterministic 1600x1200 PNGs, no user data; library metadata + 96x64 synthetic PNG thumbnails + 1KiB placeholder project blobs inserted directly into temporary IndexedDB, never opened as projects.
limitations: Headless synthetic extension-origin workload, not native OS screen capture or captureVisibleTab pipeline.
Fresh profile per root/repetition. Same host/browser required for comparison; no arbitrary thresholds.
Snapshots observe retained memory and allocator caching after closure; they do not prove leak absence.
